title: Compare CD44 Genome, Transcripts, and Protein Products

catalog.notes: Online, GUI-first comparison of the canonical 742-aa CD44 product and the 139-aa CD44RC product. The native view keeps genomic exon/CDS geometry, transcript-derived protein axes, and optional UniProt evidence separate. Public annotations can drift; the retained 2026-11-03 acceptance values are checkpoints, not timeless constants.
catalog.starting_state: A disposable empty project with online access to Ensembl and UniProt.
